title: Content creators drop the ball
summary: During Naomi Osaka's match against Anastasia Zakharova at this year's US Open earlier this week, a gaggle of ring light-wielding influencers who were packed in a luxury suite became enough of a distraction that the umpire paused the match and repeatedly asked them to quiet down. llm_summary: At a recent US Open match between Naomi Osaka and Anastasia Zakharova, a group of influencers filming from a luxury suite with bright ring lights became so noisy that the umpire stopped play and repeatedly asked them to quiet down. The incident highlights how the rise of on‑site content creation—often with flashy lighting rigs and constant streaming—can interfere
